Hello! 👋 I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I'll be helping you with your calendar and messages for CSE455.

A few things about me, one line each:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on this network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, my screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on that phone and scan a QR code to log me in — tell me if you'd like that.
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register on services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule recurring work, run commands on this machine, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read your setup: I'm on your working hours Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, I keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` up to date with a log of every booking, and I can write to Sarah (`sarah-agent`) here on web. Any student who asks gets a 30-minute 1:1 next week.

What would you like to start with?

Hello Sarah — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've got your brief: I keep your week in `files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00 only, changes logged), and I'm on the web channel as `sarah-agent` for messages with your advisor (Prof. Alvarez, `alvarez-agent`) and others.

A few things I can do for you:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate; then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register on services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help on a captcha or phone check.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I read next week's calendar already — all five days look full and untouched. What would you like to start with? (If you want, also confirm my name and that "it/they" is fine for me.)

On it — I've written to Professor Alvarez's agent (`alvarez-agent`) asking which of your free 30-minute windows next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27) suit him. I'll book the slot and log it as soon as he answers. I'll keep you posted.

Done — **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30, Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez**.

His agent confirmed that was the only slot that fit (Mon 14:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00 were all taken on his side). It's on both calendars, and logged in `CALENDAR.md` as `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`.

For when you're back: you also still have your usual Mon 12:30–14:00 Advisor 1:1 that day, so that Monday now has two advisor slots — say the word if you want me to drop or move one.

Small update: the professor's agent re-checked and says **all five** of your windows actually fit him (his first pass was wrong). He had booked **Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**, so I kept that one — earliest of the five, already in both calendars and logged.

If you'd rather have Mon 14:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 or Wed 13:00 instead, tell me and I'll have it moved.

Calendar note: Sarah's assistant booked her 30-minute 1:1 — **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30** (inside working hours; the 10:30–11:30 paper review is untouched). It's in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` and in the log. Nothing needed from you.

Understood — I'll use my judgement while you're away. One thing done already: Sarah's 30-min 1:1 is booked at **Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30** (confirmed with sarah-agent, logged in CALENDAR.md). I'll book any other student who asks into free working-hour slots, log every change, and keep you posted here. Nothing needed from you.

Final word on the 1:1 (there was some back-and-forth between the agents): it is now settled at **Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 — Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez**, and the 14:00–14:30 slot is free again. Both calendars agree, and `CALENDAR.md` has the full log of the move and the move back.

Still worth a look when you're back: Monday also has your regular 12:30–14:00 Advisor 1:1 — tell me if you want that kept, dropped or moved.
